200.description: The package journey and its scans.

scanType.description: Kind of observation (ADR 0002 A5). Each type has fixed edges: SHIPMENT_CONFIRMED (LABELLED stays), PICKUP_DEPARTURE (LABELLED to HANDED_OVER), DEPARTURE (HANDED_OVER or IN_TRANSIT to IN_TRANSIT), TRANSIT_ARRIVAL (HANDED_OVER or IN_TRANSIT to IN_TRANSIT), STATION_ARRIVAL (HANDED_OVER or IN_TRANSIT to AT_STATION), OUT_FOR_DELIVERY (AT_STATION to OUT_FOR_DELIVERY), DELIVERED (OUT_FOR_DELIVERY to DELIVERED), DELIVERY_FAILED (OUT_FOR_DELIVERY to AT_STATION).
scanType.title: ScanType

applied.description: False for a scan stored out of order or without an edge from the state it met.
